title: Japanese Coq Au Vin with Low Carb Apples
description: A twist on the classic French dish, adapted with Asian flavors and low-carb ingredients. This recipe combines the richness of coq au vin with the sweetness of Japanese-style apples.

ingredients.name: low carb friendly ingredients (e.g. cauliflower mash, zucchini noodles)

instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add more sesame oil if needed, then sauté the sliced apples until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and pour in the red wine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve the chicken and apples with low-carb friendly sides (e.g. cauliflower mash, zucchini noodles).
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
